decision.framework_outcome: C. reranker does not improve quality but stays within latency budget
decision.interpretation: Reranker@5 has no Recall@10 or Hit@10 gain, lowers MRR@10, and adds substantial measured latency versus RRF-only. Its total P95 remains under the previously established 3.5s target; no production default is selected or changed.

limitations: Only 13 current canonical queries were evaluated; 12/13 have RRF gold rank 1, leaving limited headroom for reranking gains.
This measures current canonical corpus behavior, not general reranker robustness or out-of-distribution behavior.
CPU latency varied substantially in earlier experiments; these directly observed paired-run figures are not a scaling law or a general latency guarantee.
P95 is nearest-rank on n=13 and is therefore sensitive to a small number of observations.
The same canonical strict/minimum-filter and reference-budget finalization is used in both modes; RRF-only disables inference and keeps RRF order.
